data.protocol: Purpose-selected after inspecting saved detector outputs. Exact source JPEG bytes were preserved and every classifier was repeated three times with identical scores. This pair is a teaching stress case, not a random sample, benchmark or accuracy estimate. Localisation models were not run because the exercise concerns whole-image classifier ranking and those models answer a different local-edit question.

cases.title: Purpose-selected authentic portrait
cases.dataset: Face Research Lab London Set, version 5
cases.credit: Lisa DeBruine and Benedict Jones, Face Research Lab London Set, version 5 (2017)
cases.selectionNote: Purpose-selected detector stress pair: these two portraits were selected after screening 102 authentic and 75 source-labelled synthetic portraits because several whole-image detectors reverse their ranking. This is not a random sample, benchmark or accuracy estimate.
cases.evidence: The dataset authors describe adult participants photographed in London and report signed consent for research and presentations. This is unchanged source file 025_03.jpg.
cases.limitations: Publisher-documented photographic origin; no camera RAW, independent witness record, or cryptographic capture credential was obtained. Dataset authors report signed adult consent covering lab/web studies and research illustration including presentations.

measurements.preprocessing: ufd-original-v1: RGB, torchvision CenterCrop(224), no resize or EXIF transpose, CLIP mean/std, raw non-unit-normalized CLIP features, linear head sigmoid. Single image.
measurements.note: Uncalibrated model score. Higher leans synthetic; not a probability or proof. Actual inference on saved bytes.

measurements.preprocessing: community-official-384-v1: PIL RGB, torchvision Resize(440) on the shorter side with bilinear interpolation and antialias, CenterCrop(384), ToTensor range [0,1], ImageNet mean [0.485,0.456,0.406]/std [0.229,0.224,0.225]; no EXIF transpose; float32; one central crop per image/frame.
measurements.note: Uncalibrated model score. Higher leans synthetic; not a probability or proof. Actual inference on saved bytes.

measurements.modelVersion: SPAI CVPR2025; source 8ff7b3b6779b4fcb43cf313471d9cb1c62d129a4; author checkpoint sha256 24159f27d7c8c2cd0cb6c4019189eb89ad0874a0d9d15f8dc9afd39ca9648a55; CPU FP32
measurements.preprocessing: spai-official-original-resolution-v1: PIL RGB without EXIF transpose; original resolution; centre reflection padding only if an axis is shorter than 224 px; float32 pixels /255; upstream 224x224 patches with stride 224, upstream five-crop fallback if fewer than four patches; spectral masking radius 16; learned spectral context attention aggregation; sigmoid of image-level synthetic logit. Patch feature extraction in batches of eight. Incomplete edge patches are omitted by the upstream grid when the five-crop fallback does not apply.
measurements.note: Uncalibrated synthetic-image score, not a probability or proof. Higher leans synthetic. This spectral model is a different learned signal from CLIP features; compression, resizing, camera processing and new generators can cause errors. Image-level model, not a manipulation mask or dedicated face-swap detector.

measurements.modelVersion: AIDE ICLR2025; GenImage checkpoint; source 6725b710d5c437ab2f59792908ce0377dfc907de; sha256 f084346dfb0cd05ab4201fe82a62d4f1b4381ee28f2c8295d6cb14d559a9ff16
measurements.preprocessing: aide-official-genimage-v1: PIL RGB without EXIF transpose, ToTensor [0,1]; original 32x32 DCT windows at stride16, six frequency bands select two lowest and two highest frequency patches; each patch and the full image bilinearly resized to 256x256 with torchvision antialias=True and ImageNet normalization; author SRM filters, two ResNet50 noise experts and frozen CLIP ConvNeXt-XXL semantic trunk; float32 CPU; class-1 softmax over [real,fake] logits. No resize before patch selection.
measurements.note: Uncalibrated class-1 softmax (fake), equivalent to sigmoid of fake-minus-real logits. Not a probability or authenticity verdict.

measurements.preprocessing: gend-yunet-v1: YuNet 2023mar, threshold 0.8, maximum image dimension 640; largest face; official GenD five-landmark alignment scale 1.3 and estimated square size; CLIP bicubic resize and centre crop 224, CLIP mean/std; L2-normalized pooled features, released linear head, softmax class 1; float32 CPU. One RGB image; no EXIF transpose.
measurements.note: Uncalibrated manipulation score, not a probability or forensic verdict. YuNet preprocessing differs from the research paper. Face-manipulation scope; no temporal or audio analysis. The largest face may switch between people; identities are not tracked. Validate with authentic controls and the workshop generators.

measurements.preprocessing: PIL RGB; resize exactly 256x256 with PIL bilinear interpolation; center crop224; ToTensor; ImageNet mean [0.485,0.456,0.406], std [0.229,0.224,0.225]; official test dataset transform
measurements.note: Actual local CPU inference. Uncalibrated class-1 softmax output; not a probability of authenticity. Source-documented truth remains separate from model output; no watermark or C2PA validation was performed.

cases.title: Purpose-selected AI-generated portrait

cases.selectionNote: Purpose-selected detector stress pair: these two portraits were selected after screening 102 authentic and 75 source-labelled synthetic portraits because several whole-image detectors reverse their ranking. This is not a random sample, benchmark or accuracy estimate.
cases.evidence: The publisher labels this unchanged source file as a FLUX1.dev-generated fictional adult portrait (declared age 22, seed 3768990692).
cases.limitations: Publisher-documented generated origin, not independently replayed generation or proof against resemblance to a real person. Upstream training-data and output-rights claims were not independently established. The publisher-declared MIT licence does not independently establish every upstream training-data, resemblance or output right.
